title: From Abuse to Healing: A Journey of Strength

He discusses the impact of his mother's addiction and abusive behavior, as well as the grooming and abuse he experienced from a man he trusted. Seth bravely reported his abuser, leading to his arrest and conviction. He highlights the importance of sharing stories and seeking healing, and emphasizes that everyone's story is valid and deserving of attention.
